prompts.objects: Original Mochi Mayhem mobile fantasy confectionery RPG art, stylized hand-painted 3/4 top-down with restrained rich colors and dark plum linework, tactile painted edges, readable silhouettes at 40–72 pixels. No text, alphabetic glyphs, numbers or watermarks. Create ONE transparent image atlas, PRECISE four columns by two rows, eight items, centered in evenly spaced cells, 15% clear margins around every sprite, no dividers. Portrait proportions never taller than two thirds of a cell. Labels in the prompt are only directions, never printed. Row 1 left to right: 1 small squat forest shrine of warm weathered wood and muted gold with one floating mint Wisp flame, squat base; 2 sturdy handcarved bounty signpost with a terracotta-and-cream painted bullseye pictogram; 3 flat jagged purple-glowing crack viewed from above, burnt caramel sugar rubble around the edge; 4 black-plum wispy spectral flame with two hot pink eyes, trailing a little dark translucent purple smoke. Row 2 left to right: 1 withered thorny flower, drooping layered charcoal plum petals, burgundy center and short thorns, small dirt-and-root base, no eyes; 2 floating cute but hostile half-body ghost mochi, ink-purple crimped spirit hem, one rounded dome and tiny hands, two small muted rose eyes, translucent purple at underside, facing 3/4 front-left; 3 isolated cursed branching root system extending out from a common center toward lower left, upper right and lower right, three spiny botanical tendrils in dark purple-maroon with restrained purple highlights, no flower, photographed top down and flat; 4 single industrial iron square ingredient socket tray warm ash black center and muted copper rim, little amber flames along bottom edge, no button or interior item. Ensure the sprites fill only 66% of each cell and preserve truly transparent background and clear gutters.
